meta.title: Special projects — tailored solutions with WebFully
meta.description: Larger websites, web apps, campaigns and new identities, planned and priced for you, one to one.

sections.label: Special projects / one to one
sections.title: Your project.
sections.lead: When the packages are not enough, we build from scratch. You get your own plan, your own price and one contact person from the first meeting to launch.

sections.label: When it fits
sections.title: Bigger than
sections.lead: Special projects fit when the need is unique, extensive or has to connect with several systems.

items.title: Large websites
items.text: Many pages, several languages and advanced features.

items.title: Web apps and portals
items.text: Booking, customer login and custom tools.

items.title: A new identity
items.text: A brand from scratch, with all the material.

items.title: Campaigns
items.text: Content and ads for a launch or a season.

sections.label: How it works
sections.title: Five steps.
sections.lead: We always start by understanding. The price comes when we know what is to be built.

steps.title: Walkthrough
steps.text: A free meeting about goals, needs and timeframe.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.text: A written plan with scope and timeline.

steps.title: Quote
steps.text: Fixed price or ongoing, clear from the start.

steps.title: Production
steps.text: Design and development with weekly check-ins.

items.title: Goals
items.text: What should the project achieve, and how will we know it worked?

items.title: Audience
items.text: Who will use what you build?

items.title: Timeframe
items.text: Is there a date that drives the work?

items.title: Budget
items.text: An approximate range helps us suggest the right level.

items.a: No, the first meeting is free and without obligation.

items.q: How long does a special project take?
items.a: From a few weeks to a few months. You get a timeline in the proposal.

items.q: Can we combine it with a package?
items.a: Yes, many start with a special project and continue with operations in a package.
